_about: The references for Puerto Colibrí's pictures (docs/es/PICTURES.md "References"): one portrait per person in the Spanish cast (src/editions/es/content/npcs.ts) and one picture per place, in the shared style. Situation pictures pass them as references: "person:cast/<npc id>" and "place:place/<id>". Cast portraits are 1024×1536 (2:3), places 2048×1152 (the scene size), both at high quality on gpt-image-2.5-sunburst.

items.label: The zócalo (main square)
items.prompt: The zócalo (main square) of Puerto Colibrí on a sunny late morning. In the middle distance, a little right of center, the kiosco: an octagonal stone bandstand with a few steps, slender green wrought-iron columns and railing, and a red-tiled dome with a small lantern on top. Behind it, across the square, the parroquia: a simple lime-washed colonial church in white and ochre with an arched wooden door and a bell gable with two bells. Strings of colorful papel picado run from the kiosco's eaves to the lampposts; coconut palms and a big shady laurel tree; low painted buildings with arcades along the sides; pigeons on the pale stone paving. In the left third, in the foreground, an empty green wrought-iron bench in the shade of the tree.

items.label: Doña Mari's flower stall at the tianguis
items.prompt: Doña Mari's flower stall at the Saturday tianguis on the edge of the zócalo, seen from the customer's side. The stall fills the left two thirds: a wooden table under a striped teal-and-cream canvas awning, zinc buckets of sunflowers, orange marigolds, roses, white lilies and birds of paradise, a few bunches wrapped in brown paper on the table; the vendor's spot behind the table, about one third from the left, is empty. Behind the stall, other stalls with striped awnings (fruit, embroidered blouses). The right third is the calm, open square: pale paving, and far away the kiosco with its green wrought-iron columns and red-tiled dome, and palms.

items.label: The Mercado Municipal: Doña Licha's stall
items.prompt: Inside the Mercado Municipal, a big covered market hall: a high roof of painted steel trusses with skylights, no view of the outside. Doña Licha's fruit and vegetable stall, seen from the customer's side of its counter: neat pyramids of mangoes, papayas, limes, avocados, tomatoes, green and red chiles and pink pitayas in wooden crates and tubs, a bunch of bananas hanging from a beam, an old-fashioned hanging scale with a round dial that has no numbers, a few brown paper bags. The vendor's spot behind the counter, one third from the left, is empty. Strings of papel picado under the roof; in the right third, the calm aisle of the hall with other stalls softly in the background (a chili and spice stall, baskets).

items.label: The malecón and the beach
items.prompt: The malecón (the seafront promenade) at the end of the afternoon: a wide paved walk with a low white wall, wooden benches and black lamp posts with two lanterns each, coconut palms. Beyond the wall, white sand with thatched palapas (palm-leaf umbrellas on wooden poles) and wooden loungers, the turquoise Caribbean sea, and a small wooden pier with lanchas (small open fishing boats, white with a colored stripe). In the left third, an empty bench by the wall. The right third: calm sea and sky. A few tiny figures far away on the beach.

items.label: The arrivals hall: baggage desk and customs
items.prompt: The arrivals hall of the small Puerto Colibrí airport, seen by a traveler standing at the baggage services desk: a light wood and white desk in the foreground with a computer monitor turned away from the viewer, a small printer and a stack of blank forms. The agent's spot behind the desk, one third from the left, is empty. Behind: a baggage carousel with a few suitcases, and further back the customs exit: a low stainless-steel inspection table by an open doorway, with no traffic light, button post or sign (Cancún's customs has had none since 2020), and a pale wall with a big window onto palms. Cool, bright airport light with warm accents.

items.label: Immigration control
items.prompt: Immigration control at the airport: a row of white and light-wood immigration booths with low glass screens. The booth in front of the viewer has a small counter with a passport scanner, a little fingerprint pad and a small camera on a stalk (simple shapes); the officer's seat inside the booth, one third from the left, is empty. Floor lines and a queue barrier with a fabric belt; a big window with palms and the tail of a plane behind.

items.label: The airline check-in counter
items.prompt: The airline check-in counter at the airport: a long counter with a monitor turned away from the viewer and a boarding-pass printer, a baggage scale set into the floor beside it with a conveyor belt behind. The agent's spot behind the counter, one third from the left, is empty. Behind: a wall in deep teal and a big window with palms and a bright sky.

items.label: The security checkpoint
items.prompt: The airport security checkpoint: an X-ray machine with a conveyor belt and gray plastic trays, a walk-through metal detector arch, a small table for bag checks. The screening officer's spot at the end of the belt, one third from the left, is empty. Pale walls, soft overhead light, a big window.

The agent's spot behind the gate desk, one third from the left, is empty. The right third: the calm window and sky.

The receptionist's spot behind the desk, one third from the left, is empty. The right third: a calm arch and the garden.
